Claim-matrix integrity is self-referential; individual evidence artifacts and hashes are not verified.
The performance gate does not enforce a frame-budget threshold; observed maximum frame duration reaches 41.7ms.
Accessibility tests do not cover hover, focus-visible, disabled and modal states.
required_actions: Deploy from the exact isolated staging directory. Fetch every served static artifact from the final Preview URL with byte-preserving tooling, hash the returned bytes, compare against the deployment manifest, and fail the runner on any mismatch. Record response headers and content encoding; if an intermediary transforms text bytes, define and test one canonical representation before sealing.
Add Preview, rather than only localhost :4176, as a mandatory browser-test target. Its receipt must bind final URL, deployment ID, all served hashes and test timestamp.

For every FACTUAL_VERIFIED claim, require a local immutable artifact file and sidecar whose computed hash equals the matrix value, a first-party or field-capture provenance note, capture timestamp, and a direct source URL. The runner must fail for missing files, hash mismatch, placeholder/test hashes, unsupported locality, or expired/unknown validity. Reclassify unsupported listings as AWAITING_FIELD_VERIFICATION.

Use a documented threshold for interaction responsiveness. Report per interaction sample count, p50, p95, max and count of frames above 16.7ms. The 60-FPS claim may pass only if the agreed threshold is met; otherwise report measured performance without the claim.

Exercise and measure default, hover, focus-visible, disabled and modal states for AA contrast and target geometry across 1440, 768 and 390. Fail the runner on any state that violates its applicable criterion.
Preserve all truthful simulation labels and dry-run affiliate behavior. Do not deploy, activate affiliate tracking or alter Production during remediation.
acceptance: CEO independently verifies Preview served-byte binding, replayable artifact-backed provenance, enforced performance results and full-state accessibility before any Gemini experience review.
